question: In a certain code language, 'TONE' is written as 'VPMC' and 'FIRE' is written as 'HJQC'. How will 'CITY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349d9345aa6566e72437f9f4bc00c4e55d34ec26ae0f9355a10b7dcb5695395a.png] 

the logic follows here is as,

'TONE' is written as 'VPMC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf0832aebbf1cf0e583b9882c571afce2c8ececf754eefaad5d4ce5ebec96933.png] 

'FIRE' is written as 'HJQC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f622a16972414e4711f6ab6325358b7fabe14a1c54dd72fb34754f57024e015b.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2189952f1e2a6737b429dfb86da810e5fdc9bbfdd1b5229bf4c3f428cbd2bec3.png] 

So, 'CITY' will be written as 'EJSW'.

Hence,** 'Option 4'** is the correct answer.
